title: NUTRI FIT Digital Food Scale Small Kitchen Scales Weight in Grams and OZ for Cooking Baking Weight Loss, Stainless Steel Tare & Backlit LCD Display, Black
description:
About this item
Cute & Compact: The size of the scale is close to a 6-inch mobile. Extra-slim design makes it easy to store in any cabinet while saving space for the rest of your kitchen essentials. Scale size is only for 6.14 x 4.3 x 1.1 inch.
304 Food Grade Stainless Steel Surface: Anti-fingerprint and easy-clean coating make cleaning easy. The accurate measure of the scale is better for dieting and losing weight no matter what you are on excersise or traveling.
A large backlight LCD screen that displays weights in lb:oz, g, ml, and fl.oz, Auto tare & zero Function, low power, overload indication. Perfect for home cooking ,baking, camping and food portioning.
Multifunction food scale equipped with high precision sensors and liquid measurement technolgy, provide you accurate measurements from 0.1 oz /1 g up to 5000g/11 lbs. Increment for 1g/0.1oz.
Come and use with only 2 AAA original batteries. The scale will be auto-off after 2 minutes, it will help to save the power while you are not going to use it.

reviews_1s:
The scale worked fine for 3 months. Then it wouldn't turn on. New batteries didn't help. It does not go into decimals for grams (using for sourdough), which is unfortunate, but acceptable for the price. Warranty requires return of the original, postage will cost more than the scale. The warranty support email is a Hotmail address. If you need a cheap scale for short term, this will work.Scale isn't accurate, everything seems to come in slightly under the actual weight, usually by a few grams/fraction of an ounce. Bought several of these as we use them at our work and needed replacements for ours that were dirty, none were consistent with one another or with the scale we've been using, which we know is correct.

My old scale - 8.02 oz
NutriFit scale #1 - 7.80oz
NutriFit scale #2 - 7.70oz
NutiFit scale #3 - 7.6oz-7.7oz, changed on a second weighing.

I know that it is an inexpensive scale, and it is a "get what you pay for" situation, but still. The only job of the scale is to accurately weigh things and it can't do that.I don t understand the instructions on how to use this. Also, it over estimates the amount of flour. Anyone else have these problems?I bought this for art projects requiring very precise measurements and it does not seem to be precise at all.Super smallDidn't show real numbers, sadreturned for a refund
